new_hypothesis.name: intraday_alpha_session_filter
new_hypothesis.mechanism: Copied alpha wallets exhibit different signal quality across the trading day. The 10:00-13:00 ET window is when US morning overlaps with EU close-of-day; wallets buying memes in this window are catching the second half of an Asia/EU pre-market pump that's already rolling over. The bot mirrors them late, takes the dump, and stops out. Stop-loss exit share in the 10-13 ET window is 47.3% (vs 38.9% rest-of-day) -- direct mechanistic confirmation. The MIRROR window 04:00-07:00 ET shows the same pattern (WR 22%, mean -17.5%) -- this is when Asia is winding down and US/EU haven't woken up; copied trades are chasing dead Asian tape. Symmetrically, late-evening US (23:00-02:00 ET, copy_trade WR=40.9%) is when fresh tape boots up for the new global day -- alpha is calling rather than chasing.
new_hypothesis.persistence: Three durability layers. (1) BEHAVIORAL EDGE: this is a copy-trading-specific phenomenon (signal lag from session handoffs), not a public market signal -- competitors don't time-stratify their copying because they assume 'alpha is alpha.' (2) ZERO-COMPUTE: the rule uses wall-clock time, no API; cannot be arbitraged by faster execution. (3) STRUCTURAL: Asia-EU-US session handoffs are physical (workday hours) and persist as long as global markets keep their current trading rhythm. Edge persists until alpha wallets themselves stop trading 10-13 ET, which would simply collapse the problem (no fires to skip). The rule degrades gracefully.
new_hypothesis.entry_rules: Phase 1 (HIGH-confidence cell): block ALL copy_trade entries when local Eastern hour in [10, 11, 12]. Phase 2 (after Phase 1 forward N>=20 outside blackout confirms baseline holds): widen blackout to also include hours [4, 5, 6] -- the symmetric Asia-wind-down cell. Implementation: ~3 LOC gate in copy_trade entry path, datetime.now().hour check before passing to security gate. NOT a regime filter -- applies in any regime. Strategies other than copy_trade have insufficient per-hour N (no other strategy reached N>=20 in any 3-hour window) so the rule applies only to copy_trade for now; revisit when sample grows.
new_hypothesis.data_required: ZERO new data sources. Wall-clock time only (Eastern). No new APIs, no new files, no logger required. The rule is a pure local conditional in degen_bot.py's copy_trade entry path.
new_hypothesis.evidence: Subagent A (time-of-day miner) processed N=993 closed trades from sol_trade_log.json (last 1000), 0.3% unmatched, 0% malformed timestamps. copy_trade 10-13 ET: N=70, WR=20.0%, median ROI -6.79%, mean ROI -13.98%. copy_trade all other hours: N=465, WR=35.9%, mean -5.76%. Delta WR -15.9pp. Three adjacent loss windows (04-07 ET WR=22% mean -17.5%; 05-08 ET WR=21.3% mean -18.6%; 10-13 ET WR=20% mean -14%) confirm this is not a single-cell outlier. Stop_loss exit share is 47.3% in 10-13 ET vs 38.9% baseline -- mechanism direct evidence (we are stopping out, not winning then giving back). Best windows: 23-02 ET WR=40.9%, 07-10 ET WR=39.7%, 08-11 ET WR=39.3%. Day-of-week signal weak (4.9pp spread; Tuesday best WR=39.1%, Thursday worst WR=31.4% but Thursday N=70 small). The pattern is internally robust across three independent adjacent samples. NOTE: only copy_trade reached N>=20 in any 3-hour window in last-1000 sample so other-strategy hour cells were unreliable; pattern may generalize but cannot be claimed across strategies yet.

proposals_for_survival_brain.target: PRIMARY THIS RUN: copy_trade intraday blackout. Add a wall-clock gate to copy_trade entry path: skip new copy_trade buys when datetime.now().hour in [10, 11, 12] (US/Eastern). Phase 2 (after N>=20 forward copy_trade fires confirm baseline holds outside blackout): extend blackout to also include hours [4, 5, 6]. ~3 LOC delta. No new files, no new APIs.
proposals_for_survival_brain.justification: Subagent A mined N=993 closed trades from sol_trade_log.json. copy_trade 10-13 ET: N=70 WR=20% mean -14% (vs baseline WR=35.9% mean -5.8%, delta -15.9pp WR / -8.2pp mean ROI). Stop_loss share in window is 47.3% vs 38.9% baseline, direct mechanism evidence. Three adjacent loss cells (04-07, 05-08, 10-13 ET) all show WR 20-22% confirming structural intraday cycle. Mechanism: copied alpha lags Asia-pre-EU-close session handoff; bot mirrors faded tape and stops out. Backward simulation: removing ~70 trades at avg -14% on 0.016 SOL sizing recovers ~9.8 SOL.
proposals_for_survival_brain.baseline: Per direct trade-log mining (sol_strategy_stats.json does not stratify by hour-of-day): copy_trade all-hours last-1000 N=535 WR=33.8% mean -6.86%. copy_trade 10-13 ET sub-cell N=70 WR=20.0% mean -13.98% median ROI -6.79%. Stop-loss exit share in window 47.3% vs 38.9% rest-of-day.
proposals_for_survival_brain.expected_effect: Phase 1 blackout removes ~13% of copy_trade flow (70/535 in last-1000 sample). Predicted lift: copy_trade WR remaining hours 35.9% -> stays ~36% (no degradation since we're cutting the worst cell). Predicted mean ROI improves from -6.86% to ~-5.8% on remaining flow. Predicted P/L recovery on backward sim: ~9.8 SOL over 70-day historical window if sizing is 0.016 SOL/trade. In current dormant-CHOP regime: zero immediate effect (no fires anyway); the rule activates when CHOP ends.
proposals_for_survival_brain.kill_criteria: If forward N>=20 copy_trade entries OUTSIDE the 10-13 ET blackout show WR <30% (i.e., the savings don't materialize and copy_trade is broken everywhere, not just in the blackout window), revert blackout and investigate full copy_trade kill. If forward N>=20 copy_trade entries DURING the blackout window were artificially blocked but post-hoc DexScreener forward-return check shows blocked-cohort would have had WR >=35%, revert blackout. Soft trip: if 30 calendar days pass with zero copy_trade fires (Phase 1 collateral damage too high), relax to single-hour blackout 11:00-12:00 ET only.
proposals_for_survival_brain.min_sample_size: N>=20 forward copy_trade fires (in non-blackout hours) for in-window evaluation. N>=20 simulated blocked entries (forward DexScreener pull at hour+6) for blackout-cohort evaluation.
proposals_for_survival_brain.regime_scope: ANY -- intraday session-handoff cycle is structural to global market hours, not regime-dependent. CHOP is the ambient regime; rule applies the moment CHOP ends and copy_trade fires resume.
proposals_for_survival_brain.rollback_plan: Comment out the 3-line gate; copy_trade resumes 24/7 firing.
proposals_for_survival_brain.risk_if_wrong: Worst case: alpha actually fires on a catalyst news day at 11 ET (e.g., FOMC release). We miss those rare wins. Acceptable given baseline -14% mean ROI in window. Misses on average ~1 fire/day (in active regime); if that 1 fire would have won at typical R/R 0.79, expected miss is +0.001-0.002 SOL/day -- much smaller than baseline -0.014 SOL bleed in window.
